question: If $\vec{a}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}-\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$, find a unit vector perpendicular to both $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$, with positive $\hat{k}$ component.
explanation:
Unit vector $\propto \vec{a} \times \vec{b}$

$\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 1 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 & 3 \end{vmatrix}$

$= [1\times3-(-1)\times(-2)]\hat{i} - [2\times3-(-1)\times1]\hat{j} + [2\times(-2)-1\times1]\hat{k}$

$= (3-2)\hat{i} - (6+1)\hat{j} + (-4-1)\hat{k}$

$= 1\hat{i} - 7\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}$

But $\hat{k}$ coefficient is negative, so take negative:

$-(\hat{i} - 7\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}) = -\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}$

Magnitude $= \sqrt{1+49+25} = \sqrt{75} = 5\sqrt{3}$

So unit vector:

$\frac{-\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}}{5\sqrt{3}}$.
